Title: LSJ- Parity Shift and Changing Pool Totals

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
I have 19 pool. My prey has 20 pool and Feraillle.
I call Parity Shift and terms are called "4 from my prey to me".
The action succeeded and a referendum is called.
My prey burns a pool for Feraille.
We now each have 19 pool.

Does the Parity Shift fizzle at this point in time, or does it only
check when the action is successful?

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:


Successful referendum means that (chosen) Methuselah loses that pool,
and it is allocated as you announced.
The chosen Methuselah doesn't have to have more pool than you when
votes are tallied (or when votes are cast).
